newsitem.title: PERU: PERU LOSES 80,600 MAN-HOURS IN FIRST HALF STRIKES.
newsitem.headline: PERU LOSES 80,600 MAN-HOURS IN FIRST HALF STRIKES.

text.p: The Peruvian private sector lost 80,600 man-hours in 39 registered strikes during the first half of this year, according to a monthly report released Wednesday by the labor ministry.
This was sharply down from the 635,000 man-hours lost in a total of 49 strikes during the same time last year.
The report said the sectors most affected were construction, with 52.1 percent of man-hours lost, and manufacturing, with 29.7 percent.
In June, the private sector lost 7,218 man-hours in four strikes, compared to 73,600 man-hours in five strikes during June 1996
Peru lost a total of 1.4 million man-hours in 1996, compared to 1.1 million man-hours during the previous year.
